title: Case 006: Check-Out Works: Carpet Replacement and Repainting
overview: Northbridge Lettings assigned Cedar Utilities to quote for replacing the burnt carpet and repainting the studio after the tenant vacated. The provider quoted for painting the studio and bathroom, fitting carpet and bathroom vinyl flooring, and replacing the sink waste. The landlord approved the quote. The provider was later recorded as having completed the work; the landlord was to be invoiced directly. Key return was confirmed and the request was closed after final checks.
outcome: The landlord approved the quotation, and the contractor was recorded as having completed the work. Key return was confirmed and the request was closed after final checks.
